sources.title: Gemma 4: How a 31B Model Beats 400B Rivals [2026]
sources.snippet: The 31B Dense model ranks number 3 on the Arena AI text leaderboard among all open models, while the 26B MoE variant holds the number 6 position - both outcompeting models with 20 times more parameters. This intelligence-per-parameter efficiency is what makes Gemma 4 a genuine threat to much larger proprietary systems.
